hook: Your charger may out-think the Apollo 11 computer.
title: Your Charger vs the Moon Landing Computer
description:
The Apollo Guidance Computer had about 4 KB of RAM and 72 KB of storage, and it helped land humans on the Moon. Some modern fast chargers contain chips more capable than that. Space history sounds fake until you compare the numbers.

#Shorts #Apollo11 #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Moon landing on 4 KB: genius or luck? Genius or luck
